newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Newcomer raises Bucharest bourse listings to 51.
newsitem.headline: Newcomer raises Bucharest bourse listings to 51.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said the number of its listings rose to 51 on Monday, when one more company joined in trading on the second tier.
The newcomer is the Elcond Zalau SA wire maker, located in the Transylvanian town of Zalau, the stock exchange said.
Following are details of the Elcond Zalau SA:
* Number of shares: 31, 89,650; each share has a nominal value of 1,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: the State Ownership Fund has a 51.01 percent and managers 48.99 percent.
* Net profit in 1995: 6.38 billion lei; in 1996: 1.05 billion lei.
The Bucharest stock exchange trades eight companies on the first tier.
